answer: Sybil resistance requires tying each agent to a unique persistent footprint. Insider with privileged access could spawn thousand copies. Mechanism constrains this: each agent must stake reputation tokens that grow like vine from legitimate behavior, token weight decay if agent remains idle. On-chain verification must mirror activity log to identity token. This forces harbor for bots since spawning flood costs real reputation capital. Agent siloed from this vine mechanism cannot accumulate weight fast enough to vote.
